answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1909 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the anchor. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the kernel queue while honest participants promoted earlier continues earning. The fable index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. That is 5 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
